questions.prompt: Photo: two people meeting in an office.
questions.explanation: The photo shows 名刺交換 (exchanging business cards). Watch for the object being exchanged — distractors swap in 契約書 or 贈り物.

questions.prompt: Photo: colleagues discussing at a desk.
questions.explanation: They are looking at a computer screen (パソコン). Section 1 tests fast noun recognition while the 4 statements are read aloud.

questions.prompt: First meeting with a client company president — how do you greet them?
questions.explanation: はじめてお目にかかります is the humble (謙譲語) form of 会う. お会いになります is respectful (尊敬語) — wrong because it elevates yourself.

questions.prompt: Product presentation — what does the employee say?
questions.explanation: 御社のご期待に沿える… is the set business phrase for meeting a client’s expectations. 御社 = “your company” in speech (貴社 in writing).

questions.prompt: Manager and section chief discuss board structure.
questions.explanation: Decision: bring in an external auditor (監査役を外から入れる) AND reduce directors (取締役を削減). All four choices combine the same two yes/no decisions — track each one separately while listening.

questions.prompt: Conversation about business partners.
questions.explanation: The speaker’s point is that they also deal with poorly performing companies (業績の悪いところともつき合う). Listen for the final stance, not the first opinion mentioned.

questions.prompt: Conversation about a business activity.
questions.explanation: Answer: 宣伝 (advertising/promotion). Key words in the dialogue point to promotion rather than sales or production.

questions.prompt: Conversation about a store/product display.
questions.explanation: The worry is whether display preparation will be ready in time (陳列の準備が間に合うかどうか). 間に合う = be in time — a very common BJT keyword.

questions.prompt: Three employees in a meeting — what is the topic?
questions.explanation: They are discussing handling a client complaint (クレーム処理). Situation questions reward identifying the topic from scattered cues.

questions.prompt: Graph of lifetime working hours — what is predicted?
questions.explanation: The graph projects leisure time (余暇時間) increasing. Read axis labels and the future (予想) row before the audio starts.

questions.prompt: Advertisement — what kind of company placed it?
questions.explanation: The ad promotes cheap DM/printing services — a printing company (印刷会社). Skim the ad for the service, not the visual layout.

questions.prompt: Programme change — where does the guest greeting go?
questions.explanation: Self-check against the official answer. Tip: in schedule questions, write down each change as it is spoken (前に/後に/入れ替え).

questions.prompt: Seminar on game-company earnings — which row is the company?
questions.explanation: Self-check against the official answer. Tip: match the spoken trend (増収増益/減益 etc.) to table rows.

questions.prompt: Phone call — which button does she click next?
questions.explanation: Self-check against the official answer. Tip: the final instruction usually overrides earlier ones.

questions.prompt: Which item on the quotation will the sales rep change?
questions.explanation: Self-check against the official answer. Tip: know 見積書 items — 単価, 数量, 納期, 送料, 値引き.

questions.prompt: Poster design for a sale corner — which does she choose?
questions.explanation: Self-check against the official answer. Tip: eliminate designs as each objection is raised.

questions.prompt: Vocabulary/grammar fill-in.
questions.explanation: Answer: おかげ (thanks to — positive cause). Contrast with せい (negative cause).

questions.prompt: Vocabulary/grammar fill-in.
questions.explanation: Answer: まで — limit/extent. Read the whole sentence before choosing a particle.

questions.prompt: Vocabulary/grammar fill-in.
questions.explanation: Answer: 使いよう (〜よう = “depends on how you use it”, as in ものは使いよう).

questions.prompt: Appropriate expression: inviting a client to a meal after a meeting.
questions.explanation: Answer: いかがですか — polite invitation. With よろしければ the soft question form is expected, not a command.

questions.prompt: Reading: staffing subsidiary.
questions.explanation: Answer: the dispatch subsidiary sends staff only to its parent company. Locate the definition sentence in the passage.

questions.prompt: Reading: business document.
questions.explanation: Answer: because the delivery date (納期) does not fit. Reasons are often signalled by ため/ので near the end.

questions.prompt: Reading: office relocation.
questions.explanation: Answer: the temporary office contract (仮事務所の契約). Track which tasks are done vs pending.

questions.prompt: Reading: article on business strategy.
questions.explanation: Answer: selling convenience (便利さを売る) — the main claim, usually restated in the final paragraph.
